title: Effect of Breathing a Krypton-Oxygen Mixture on Signaling Cascades in Rat Brain during Simulation of Photoinduced Ischemic Stroke.
authors: Antonova, V V; Shumov, I V; Dolgikh, V T; Grebenchikova, A A; Gabitov, M V; Yakupova, E I; Grebenchikov, O A
journal: Bulletin of experimental biology and medicine
one_liner_zh: 该文研究氪氧混合气对大鼠脑缺血模型中NF-κB等信号通路的影响，仅涉及转录因子表达检测，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: We studied the effect of a krypton-oxygen mixture on the key signaling pathways associated with ischemic tolerance and suppression of secondary damage in a model of photoinduced stroke in male Wistar rats. In animals breathing the krypton-oxygen mixture, the expression of the transcription factor NF-kappaB (p50) in the brain was suppressed, indicating anti-inflammatory shifts in the brain tissue upon exposure to krypton, in parallel, increased content of phosphorylated forms of glycogen synthase kinase 3beta (GSK-3beta) and protein kinase B (Akt), components of the preconditioning cascade, was revealed. These results indicate a high potential of krypton in reducing acute cerebral disorders.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了氪氧混合气对雄性Wistar大鼠光诱导卒中模型中与缺血耐受及继发性损伤抑制相关的关键信号通路的影响。在呼吸氪氧混合气的动物中，大脑中转录因子NF-kappaB (p50)的表达受到抑制，表明暴露于氪时脑组织出现抗炎性变化；同时，发现糖原合酶激酶3beta (GSK-3beta)和蛋白激酶B (Akt)的磷酸化形式含量增加，这些是预处理级联反应的组成部分。这些结果表明氪在减轻急性脑部疾病方面具有巨大潜力。
